Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the slate Titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 at $184 off, $130 off the aluminum Cell model, and more from $299. The rare Apple keyboards and black Magic Mouse deals are (somehow) still live, and we have a solid discount on my personal favorite Anker Prime Power Bank that doubles as wall charger, but today’s real accessory highlight is Nomad’s giant sitewide Anniversary sale with rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, Find My cards, Watch bands, more. Head below for a closer look at the details.

Score a new set of AirPods Pro 3 for the summer at nearly $50 off right now, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 (Reg. $179)

Now live again: Slate Titanium 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $184 off at Amazon right now

This deal went out of stock very quick yesterday, so you might not want to sleep on it today if you’re interested. Apple’s Slate Titanium 46mm GPS + Cell Series 11 is now $184 off the list price at Amazon again.

Amazon is now offering the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model with the Slate Titanium Case and the Black Sport Band down at $564.97 shipped.

This is one of the top-end Titanium case models that carries a $749 list price. With today’s, presumably, short-lived deal you can score one at $184 off the sticker price to deliver one of the better deals we have tracked on this model. It did fall to $550 for a very short time ahead of Prime Day last month, but this is otherwise the best deal we have tracked on this configuration.

Again, this deal is only for folks specifically looking towards that gorgeous Titanium build and Slate finish, as you are, even with the deal, going to be paying for it. That said, there are solid $100 and $130 price drop like across the more popular aluminum models in the Series 11 lineup this week as well:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (Reg. $529)

Rare Apple keyboards and black Magic Mouse deals (somehow) still live, all-time lows from $80

We certainly see our fair share of deals on prime time Apple tech – AirPods Pro 3 are $50 off and the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models are up to $130 off right now – but the Magic accessories, not so much. However, we are (somehow) still seeing lingering Prime Day price drops on both the base Magic Keyboard and the full-size model with Touch ID, as well as the black Apple Magic Mouse. 

Previous to these extended Prime Day discounts, deals on these Apple accessories were very rare, and there’s no telling how much longer these offers will remain.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID $145 (Reg. $179)

All three are sitting at the lowest prices we have tracked on Amazon to date. It had been a very long time since we had seen the black Apple Magic Mouse down at a price this low (I’m certainly looking to score a backup at the moment), and both of these Magic Keyboard models are at the lowest prices ever – only once before this recent sale has the base model been down this low and we had never seen the Touch ID variant under $158.

If you are looking to refresh your Magic Apple input devices, now might be the time to do it while these ongoing Prime Day prices are still poppin’.

Nomad’s giant sitewide Anniversary sale now live: Rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, Watch bands, more

Rare 20% price drops hit Nomad’s gorgeous metal/glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands today

There are far more affordable 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stands out there, but there are almost none quite as premium and gorgeous as the latest Nomad models. They are not cheap, but with the brand’s 2026 Anniversary Sale now live we are now tracking rare price drops on both the 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 models for your entire Apple EDC.

The Nomad 2026 Anniversary sale is now live with loads of discounts on its iPhone 17 cases, wallets, Apple Watch bands, and other charging gear, but these Stand One and Stand One Max deals are among the most rare of them all:

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One $103 (Reg. $129)
  • Nomad 3-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One Max $135 (Reg. $169)

You’re looking at the latest generation 25W Qi2 MagSafe stands from Nomad. They are now 20% off, which might not seem like a ton, but they are almost never on sale.

We are talking about premium solid and incredibly weighty metal construction here with glass finishes that provide the elegant and luxurious home your Apple gear deserves.

The only thing bad about this deal is that the new Cosmic Orange colorway is not included in the sale:

Rare price drops hit Nomad’s Tracking Card: Apple Find My Pro model, Cosmic orange, Google Find Hub, more

The Nomad Anniversary Sale is now live, and while we had a bit of a false start on the Tracking Card Pro and Air deals, they are now live. The deals aren’t massive, but we are talking about rare price drops here, including both the Apple Find My and Google Find Hub editions starting from $32.

The Nomad Tracking Cards are easily some of the best in the business, complete with wireless MagSafe charging – I never leave home without one:

  • Tracking Card Air $32 (Reg. $35)
    • Apple Find My or Google Find Hub
  • Tracking Card Pro $41 (Reg. $45)
    • All three colors

Nomad’s Titanium Stratos Apple Watch bands now 20% off in Anniversary sale (Rare deal)

My personal favorite Anker Prime Power Bank with display doubles as wall charger down at $70 in summer sale

The 2026 Anker summer rolls on with loads of deals across its latest Prime charging gear devices, power banks, desktop chargers, 25W MagSafe stations, and more. One of my personal favorite of the brand’s portable power options has also returned to the 2026 low at $69.99 – the 9,600mAh Anker Prime Power Bank that also doubles as a wall charger.

The 9,600mAh Anker Prime Power Bank is now selling for $69.99 shipped at Amazon. Regularly as much as $90, we have tracked this same deal a number of times this year, but I wanted to make sure this one didn’t get lost in the shuffle this week as it has been the most useful piece of portable charging kit I have had in my setup for code to a year now.

There are certainly more powerful power banks in the brand’s current-gen lineup, with more battery capacity and faster charging output, but this one has been supremely useful for me. One of the more compact options it has, it can easily slide into my EDC while still delivering the onboard smart display, USB-C connectivity, and more than enough juice to give me boost when out of the house for the day or more.

Check out my hands-on review right here.

This is also one of the only models in the lineup that also doubles as a wall charger. There are fold-down outlet prongs right on the back of the power bank so you can juice up the internal battery while also using it as a wall charger – I love this and I don’t need to carry a another device in my kit to power it back up.

  • Anker 10-port flat plug power strip now down at $20 via Amazon

Still live: Anker’s 3-port 160W Smart Display charger back at Prime Day price (33% off), more from $8

Alongside the ongoing price drops on Anker’s display-equipped Qi2 25W smart charger and its latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe Charging Station, we are also tracking its 160W display-laded 3-port Prime Charger back at its Prime Day price (33% off).

The official Amazon Anker store is now offering its Smart Display 3-port Prime Charger down at $99.99 shipped.

That’s not cheap for what is effectively a wall charger, but we are talking about one with a built-in Smart Display that can deliver up to 160W of juice from a form-factor “as compact as an AirPods Pro 3 case, making it easy to carry yet powerful enough to handle your devices.”

More specially, it can deliver up to 140W of juice from a single USB-C port, which can charge “16-inch MacBook Pro from 0 to 50% in just 25 minutes.”

As far as the Smart Display goes, it delivers AnkerSense View tech so you can “monitor power in real time on screen, switch modes instantly, and unlock custom modes through the app via Bluetooth.”
